vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.title: across 与 cross：介词/副词和动词的区别
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.explanation: across 通常作介词或副词，表示从一边到另一边，作介词时后接名词，如 walk across the bridge；cross 是动词，直接接宾语，如 cross the bridge。不能说 cross across the bridge，除非 across 属于另一个独立结构。
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.source: The old bridge across the river. / The old bridge crosses the river.
vocabulary:across-preposition-adverb-vs-.example: We walked across the bridge, and then we crossed the street.

vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.title: boat：小船 / 船
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.explanation: boat 是日常词，通常指尺寸较小、可用于休闲、渡水或短途航行的船。在 sailing 语境里，boat 可以泛指要开出去的帆船或小艇。
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.source: Shall we take the boat out this morning?
vocabulary:boat-small-watercraft.example: We rented a small boat for the afternoon.

vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.title: breeze：微风
vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.explanation: breeze 指轻柔、舒服的风，比 wind 更具体、更温和。在海边或户外活动中，a nice breeze 常表示天气宜人，也适合帆船借风航行。
vocabulary:breeze-light-wind.example: A cool breeze came in from the sea.

vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.title: drizzle 表示毛毛雨或下毛毛雨
vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.explanation: drizzle 可作名词，表示很细、很轻、持续落下的小雨；也可作动词，表示下毛毛雨。它比 rain 更轻，比 shower 更细碎、持续感更强。
vocabulary:drizzle-light-rain.example: It started to drizzle on my way home. 我回家路上开始下毛毛雨了。

vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.title: harbor：港口 / 避风港
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.explanation: harbor 指船只停靠、避风或装卸的地方。在日常航海、旅行语境中，它常指码头附近受保护的水域。
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.source: Let's meet at the harbor at ten.
vocabulary:harbor-place-for-boats.example: The small boats were tied up in the harbor.

vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.title: plate 作动词：摆盘
vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.explanation: plate 作动词时通常指把食物放到盘子上并摆放得好看，常见于厨师、餐厅或烹饪节目语境，比 dish up 更强调外观和呈现。
vocabulary:plate-as-verb-arrange-food.example: The chef plated the dessert with fresh berries.

vocabulary:review-core-meaning.title: review 的核心含义
vocabulary:review-core-meaning.explanation: review 作动词表示复习、审查或回顾，作名词表示复习、审查、评论；具体含义由语境决定。
vocabulary:review-core-meaning.example: I need to review my notes before the exam.

vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.title: slice：切成片
vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.explanation: slice 强调把食物切成薄片或片状，常搭配 bread、tomatoes、onions、meat 等；名词 slice 也可表示“一片”。
vocabulary:slice-cut-into-thin-pieces.example: Slice the tomatoes before you make the salad.

vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.title: stir：搅拌
vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.explanation: stir 指用勺子或类似工具搅动液体、糊状物或锅里的食物，让材料混合或受热均匀；常见搭配是 stir the soup、stir the sauce。
vocabulary:stir-mix-by-moving-spoon.example: Stir the soup for a few minutes.
